blocks.content: The viewport meta tag is essential for responsive design (designing the website to adapt based on the user's device size).

items: content="width=device-width" sets the width of the viewport to be the same as the width of the device.

blocks.content: This metadata makes the webpage fit the user's screen.
The viewport meta is more useful when working with CSS. We will return to it in the CSS course.
